limitations: Hand-authored prototype from a partial source read of the public alpha; not produced by the state builder. The GitHub worker, dashboard and settings modules were not described.

sections.title: What atmin review does
sections.summary: Source code review with evidence, clear verdicts and bounded model spending. Runs as a CLI or as a GitHub App worker; experimental alpha whose model quality and severity calibration are still being measured.

sections.title: Review engine and CLI
sections.summary: package.json exposes two binaries: atmin-review (dist/cli.js: prepare, investigate, review, render, cost) and atmin-review-github (dist/github/cli.js). The engine is src/*.ts; the GitHub App worker lives under src/github/.

sections.title: Prepare, investigate, render
sections.summary: prepare captures an immutable snapshot (bare source.git, packet.json, change.diff, initial result.json) with read-only GitHub access. investigate runs the model against that snapshot with bounded reads and usage reservations; a run that has started or spent cannot be reset or resumed. render validates every evidence reference against captured Git objects.

sections.title: Findings cite controller-captured source
sections.summary: A finding is accepted only when it cites controller-captured read_file evidence for its exact anchor path, side and line; declared reasoning cannot support a finding. Results are advisory: never GitHub approvals or a protected merge check.

sections.title: Controller-authored messages only
sections.summary: Validation and failure messages are written by the controller; provider, SDK and OS errors are never wrapped or echoed because they can carry request content or private data. Git runs with an isolated environment and configuration.

sections.title: Contribution rules
sections.summary: Use Node 24+, run npm ci and npm test, and include a focused regression for behavior changes. Keep source review separate from repository execution; preserve bounded spending, credential separation and honest incomplete verdicts.

sections.title: Build and test
sections.summary: npm run build compiles with tsc; npm test builds and then runs node --test test/*.test.mjs; npm run typecheck runs tsc --noEmit.

sections.title: change-validation workflow
sections.summary: The change-validation job runs on push, pull_request and workflow_dispatch with Node 24: npm ci --ignore-scripts, npm test, then node packaging/verify.mjs, which packs and installs the tarball and renders a saved review.

sections.title: A successful model response can still leave a review incomplete
sections.summary: The input-count guard uses a conservative local adapter estimate rather than provider context exhaustion, and reporting-time failures are distinct from transport failures. Accepted in the frozen 2026-09-14 comparison; not a regression to report on unrelated PRs.

sections.title: Reporting reserve heuristic
sections.summary: The controller reserves time for discovery closure and reporting from observed request latency. The reserve is headroom, not a guarantee about provider latency; changes here alter when navigation tools disappear.

sections.title: Local Codex usage accounting
sections.summary: The local Codex adapter derives per-turn usage from lifetime session totals reported by CLI 0.145; a CLI change in usage reporting silently breaks token accounting and reservations.
